# GLOSSARY.md at the root in Pocock's format with term anchors for the round trip; ADRs as…

GLOSSARY.md at the root in Pocock's format with term anchors for the round trip; ADRs as docs/adr/NNNN-slug.md read back by hash, the record winning a clash with the file's text kept as a note

- Glossary: the docs-sync round trip is kept; each term keeps its `<a id>` anchor and the parser also reads Pocock's `**Term**:` line as the section's heading. The file moved to the repo root; the generated copy under docs/ is removed.
- ADRs: adr-files.js writes one file per adr record with Pocock's ADR-FORMAT (title, prose; status and the record's uid in front matter), numbered by links.madr (shared with the MADR files, never reused). The hash of the text last written is kept in meta; a different file is a hand edit: taken into the record when the record did not change since, else kept as a note on the task.
- Found on the way: exportDocs, which wrote the MADR decision files, had no caller since #73. The side files (decisions, ADRs, the old glossary's removal) now run at the end of syncDocs too, after decisions are numbered.
